question: Should a client get a Field's id in the outputs it already receives (A) or through a separate name-to-id read (B)?
options: Do nothing: clients see names only; srs-web keeps no field option; b2ff7c91 stays unmet in these outputs

options.action: A: id beside name in the authoring schema and facets
options.leads_to: one mechanism, no extra calls, RFC-039's retirement reversed by name

options.action: B: a separate (typeId, typeVersion, name) -> fieldId read plus facets listing contributing Types
options.leads_to: schema stays id-free; a second mechanism; one call per Type per view

recommend: A: id beside name in the authoring schema and facets
why: one way over many; a lookup cannot fix a merged facet
